D5/S3/Geometry/TwoAxisFiniteRotation.mov.name: D5.S3.Geometry.TwoAxisFiniteRotation.moving_axis_invariance
D5/S3/Geometry/TwoAxisFiniteRotation.mov.signature: theorem moving_axis_invariance {Y : Type*} (F : (Space × Space) → Y) (p : Space × Space) (a b : Space) (hab : ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ ^ 2 < ‖a‖ ^ 2 * ‖b‖ ^ 2) (hlocal : ∀ (O : Orthogonal), determinant O = 1 → ∀ (T : Orthogonal), (T ∈ axisCircle (O a) ∨ T ∈ axisCircle (O b)) → F (rotatePair T (rotatePair O p)) = F (rotatePair O p)) (R : Orthogonal) (hR : determinant R = 1) : F (rotatePair R p) = F p

D5/S3/Geometry/TwoAxisFiniteRotation.two.signature: theorem two_axis_finite_word (a b : Space) (hab : ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ ^ 2 < ‖a‖ ^ 2 * ‖b‖ ^ 2) (R : Orthogonal) (hR : determinant R = 1) : ∃ l : List Orthogonal, IsAxisWord a b l ∧ l.prod = R
